messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: GPU pool 'infer-prod-eu' queue growth detected (>120s avg wait). autoscaler attempts failing (rate limit), throttling observed. Paging @sarah_oncall and @mike_sre :rotating_light:

sarah_oncall: I'm on it. taking pager. linking runbook: https://intranet/redwood/runbooks/gpu-exhaustion

mike_sre: grabbing logs now. curious if this aligns with the morning rollout — @anya_ml did the v2.3.1 model go live?

anya_ml: confirmed, v2.3.1 rolled at 09:12 UTC with longer default context (8k -> 32k) and kv-cache adjustments. We saw perf locally but not at scale.

mike_sre: looking at autoscaler: it's attempted scale-outs but hit provider quota + our safety cap (pool-max 42). requests are piling in FIFO, queue length up to 6k, avg token latency climbing.

incidents-bot: deploy-bot: rollout v2.3.1 -> 100% at 1764321150 (automated).

sarah_oncall: root cause hypothesis: model's longer context increases KV cache churn and per-token work -> effective GPU throughput drop -> queues grow -> autoscaler keeps adding pods but scheduling fails / hits limit. Need immediate mitigations: 1) reduce traffic to v2.3.1, 2) increase pool capacity if possible, 3) apply protective throttles.

mike_sre: trying to throttle at edge. setting per-tenant rate limit to 60rpm for heavy customers. patching gateway config now: `gateway.rate_limit.set("prod-heavy", 60)`

devops-bot: Request submitted to cloud provider to raise GPU quota. Ticket #CLD-98412. Estimated ETA variable.

anya_ml: can we Canary rollback? I can push v2.3.0 routing override to 100% for affected shard. If we cut v2.3.1 to 0% that should drop load and kv-cache pressure.

sarah_oncall: do it. Jordan, can we send an external status update? customers already contacting support.

jordan_pm: drafting status: "We are mitigating an elevated latency and throttling issue affecting text-generation on EU region. Engineers are rolling back a model variant to reduce load. We will update in 30m." Posting to status page now.

mike_sre: rollback command queued: `deploy-router set-weight model:v2.3.1 0 --shard infer-prod-eu`

incidents-bot: deploy-bot: routing change applied (v2.3.1 -> 0% in infer-prod-eu) at 1764321789.

mike_sre: monitoring... queue length dropping from 6k -> 1.2k over the last 3 min. tailing logs show reduced memory pressure on hosts. latency for tail requests falling.

anya_ml: confirming KV cache hit-rate improved after routing change. this supports the kv-cache churn hypothesis. we'll schedule a patch to the model to cap ctx window per-request default and improve cache key stability.

ops-runner: manual capacity bump completed: added 6 nodes to reserved pool (manual scale) to give headroom while autoscaler bug investigated. cloud ticket updated.

devops-bot: autoscaler error: `scale_up_failed: reached configured safety cap (pool-max)` logged repeatedly. Investigation open in infra repo: https://git.redwood/infra/issues/1279

sarah_oncall: good. that's enough to stabilize immediate customer impact. next steps: 1) keep v2.3.1 at 0% until repro fixed; 2) create hotfix to default to smaller context and kv-cache tuning; 3) fix autoscaler to honor emergency-upscale IAM path; 4) post-incident comms and CS runbook for impacted customers.

jordan_pm: CS note: affected tenants (enterprise EU) saw 502s and elevated latencies between 09:20 and 09:46 UTC. I'll coordinate outreach.

mike_sre: handoff: @mike_sre -> @sarah_oncall (continuing) for another 10m then @ana_nightshift will take over. leaving current logs, dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/GPUPool/infer-prod-eu?from=now-1h

sarah_oncall: acknowledged. compiling incident timeline and initial impact numbers. will start a postmortem doc after stabilization.

anya_ml: quick note for postmortem: model change log - increased default max_context to 32k, changed kv-cache sharding behavior (more frequent evictions). rollback followed by improved hit-rate. will include perf test gaps.

mike_sre: adding temporary guard in router to reject requests with ctx_len > 12k until model patched. `router.policy.add("ctx_limit", 12000)`

incidents-bot: STATUS UPDATE: mitigation successful. queue stabilized. autoscaler still showing errors; manual capacity present. Incident severity downgraded to S2 at 1764323000.

jordan_pm: pushing update to status page: "Mitigations in place; rollback completed; manual capacity added; we're monitoring."

sarah_oncall: handoff to night shift @ana_nightshift. key actions for next oncall: follow autoscaler fix, validate canary for patched model, confirm quotas with cloud. leaving notes in postmortem draft.

ops-runner: saved snapshot of host stats and full collector traces to /incidents/1764321987/ for postmortem.

mike_sre: closing loop on immediate action items. will open infra PR to add emergency-upscale runbook and fix pool-max default.

anya_ml: I'll prepare a model patch with context cap + kv-cache tweaks and a limited canary plan (5% -> 20% -> 50%).

sarah_oncall: thanks all. final update before handoff: customers impacted reduced to a small subset, service recovered. Postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:
